import csv

# Calculate outstanding chairs for each person
outstanding = {}
for name, borrowed, returned in [("Noor", 17, 3), ("Ada", 9, 6), ("Lin", 12, 4)]:
    outstanding[name] = borrowed - returned

# Write to chairs.csv
with open("chairs.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["name", "outstanding"])
    writer.writeheader()
    for name, value in outstanding.items():
        writer.writerow({"name": name, "outstanding": value})

# Calculate total outstanding chairs
total = sum(outstanding.values())
print(total)
